name: Reference soil Italy 11
summary: A reddish shrink–swell clay from the hills of central Italy. Wet winters and dry summers make the clay swell and crack, which churns the soil and carves wedge-shaped blocks with shiny shear faces.
credit: Photo: ISRIC World Soil Reference Collection, CC BY-SA 3.0 https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:ISRIC_monolith_IT-011.jpg — Site and horizon data condensed from ISRIC – World Soil Information https://isis.isric.org/monoliths/reference-soil-it011 — Feature notes written for this site.

horizons.name: Ap1
horizons.description: Dark reddish brown (5YR 3/3 moist) clay; moderate fine and medium crumb structure; very friable; very few weathered limestone gravels; abrupt smooth boundary.

horizons.name: Ap2
horizons.description: Dark reddish brown (5YR 3/3 moist) clay; moderate medium subangular blocky and fine crumb structure; friable; broken thin clay–humus cutans in root channels; very few small hard Mn nodules; abrupt smooth boundary.

horizons.name: 2Bt
horizons.description: Dark reddish brown (5YR 3/4 moist) clay; moderate to strong medium and coarse angular blocky structure; firm; few coarse distinct mottles (5YR 4/6); broken thick clay–sesquioxide cutans on ped faces; clear smooth boundary.

horizons.name: 2Btg1
horizons.description: Dark reddish brown (5YR 3/4 moist) clay; moderate to strong coarse and very coarse wedge-shaped angular blocky structure; firm; common coarse distinct mottles (5YR 4/6, 2.5YR 4/6); broken thick clay–sesquioxide cutans; slickensides; gradual smooth boundary.

horizons.name: 2Btg2
horizons.description: Dark reddish brown (5YR 3/4 moist) clay; strong coarse and very coarse wedge-shaped angular blocky structure; very firm; few to common distinct mottles (5YR 5/6, 2.5YR 3/4); patchy thick clay–sesquioxide cutans on ped faces; slickensides; diffuse smooth boundary.

features.title: Crumbly topsoil
features.description: Small crumbs and fine roots at the surface. Dry-season cracking breaks the clay into this loose layer.

features.title: Limestone fragment
features.description: Pale fragment of weathered limestone, a few of which are scattered in the upper soil.

features.title: Shrinkage crack
features.description: Horizontal crack opened as the clay dried. In summer, cracks like these can reach deep into the profile.

features.title: Slickenside
features.description: Dark, polished shear face. Swelling clay pushes blocks past each other, smoothing their surfaces. This is the hallmark of Vertisols.

features.title: Dark coated block
features.description: Ped face darkened by clay and oxide coatings.

features.title: Wedge-shaped ped
features.description: Inclined shear plane bounding a wedge-shaped block, formed by repeated swelling and shrinking.
